title: familiar.tools.json
description: Schema for familiar tool manifests. Each file is a JSON array of tool definitions.

tool_name.description: Unique identifier for the tool. Use dot-namespacing for grouping, e.g. 'todos.add'.

description.description: Natural language explanation of what the tool does. This is used by the AI router to decide when to call the tool.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the arguments the tool accepts. Follows JSON Schema Draft 07.

input_mode.description: How user input is passed to the tool. 'processed' means arguments are extracted from the message. 'raw' means the full message text is passed as a single string argument.

executor_payload.description: Optional template for the payload sent to the executor. Use tokens like $tool_name, $arguments, $execution_id.

policy.description: Optional policy configuration for this tool. Reserved for future use.

status.description: Whether the tool is active and available for routing.

base_url.description: Optional per-tool URL override. If set, this tool's executor calls go to this URL instead of the integration base_url.
